settings.title: California Proposition 65
settings.text: P65 warning requires products sold in the State of California to display a warning label indicating any traces of chemicals known to the State to cause birth defects or other reproductive harm. Visit www.P65Warnings.ca.gov for more information. Product labels displaying P65 Warning conform to this law.

settings.title: Lead Free/Low Lead
settings.text: Reduction of Lead in Drinking Water Act that went into effect in 2014 was a new law redefining "lead-free" or "low lead" under the Safe Drinking Water Act of 1974. This new law states that no more than a weighted average of 0.25% lead when used with respect to the wetted surfaces of pipes, pipe fittings, plumbing fittings and fixtures. Product labels displaying "low lead" or "lead free" are equivalent and conform to the new law.

settings.title: AB 1953
settings.text: California Assembly Bill 1953 (AB1953) prohibits the use of any pipe, pipe or plumbing fitting, or fixture intended to convey or dispense water for human consumption through drinking water or cooking that is not lead free in California. Products that do not meet the criteria as outlined by AB1953 by January 1, 2010, cannot be sold in the State of California. Product lables displaying AB1953 conform to this bill in the State of California.
